component.name: BigScreen Launcher
component.summary: A flatpak app selector meant for TV screens

description.p: BigScreen Launcher is a GTK4 application designed for HTPC (Home Theater PC) environments. It displays installed Flatpak applications in a horizontal scrollable grid with full controller and keyboard support.

ul.li: Horizontal scrolling grid layout optimized for TV screens
Full gamepad/controller support (D-Pad navigation, A/B buttons)
Configurable grid dimensions and scrolling modes
Steam integration with Big Picture and PC modes

description.p: Initial beta release with core functionality
